[quote=koranvistan;61237312][i]"Hmm.. I know the Palace Historical society wants to start hosting official festivities again, so they're in charge of planning the dance. I'm sure you've seen some of them around, Margaret is usually going from the library to the records office they keep here."[/i] She finished the last of her drink and set the glass on a short table beside the chair. [i]"On that first night I just know the town square will be aglow and the city will feel so alive. There's this little spot under the Central Bridge I like to hang out at when the night comes to an end. My favorite holiday, and I'm so lucky to spend it with you."[/i] She cupped Cecilia's cheek with her hand, leaning close to kiss her.[/quote]

Cecilia gazed intensely into Elenas eyes as she leaned in. Her mind raced; she knew what was coming. 

There was a fluttering in her stomach, her heart skipped a beat and pounded fast in her chest. She moved the arm holding the glass of wine far from them so as to not spill it over herself, and gently placed a hand on the side of Elenas neck. A light smile formed on her lips. [i]Youre so beautiful, Elena. Im the lucky one.[/i]

She closed her eyes as their lips met.
